# Waymark 0.2.11

Fixes live pet soul tracking stopping after login. Waymark now keeps the capture handle for an active game connection open when unrelated sockets change. New connections receive separate exact-endpoint filters, and retired filters are closed without interrupting the active stream. TCP ordering and retransmission deduplication stay intact; identity is never copied to another connection.

A live Global validation detected Jilara's fresh login and saved two Skama soul gains and one Sylphen soul gain without relogging. The validation used the corrected reader with isolated local data. A regression check also verifies that a fragmented pet message survives unrelated socket additions and removals.

Includes the glowing player dot from 0.2.10: pulsing teal for live position, and a larger steady amber glow for last known. Existing saved progress, pets, pins and routes are preserved. A fresh login is required after restarting the reader mid-session.
